title: Unique Cages [III]
description:
Custom Rules: 
- Digits do not repeat in Cages. Each Cage has an unique sum that needs to be determined.
- Cage-Sums must form a consecutive sequence of sums - without repeating sums - so, if a lowest Cage would be the sum of 1, then the total number of Cages is the total sum of the highest Cage-Sum.
- Two Cages separated by letter [C] means that the sum of those Cages must be consecutive.

Ps. I've written out the Progressive-Hints for the full logical Solve-Path in comments.
